description: This Java class 'ICalWorker' handles WebDAV requests related to iCalendar data within the OFBiz framework. It manages calendar retrieval, updates, and WebDAV property handling, delegating calendar conversion tasks to 'ICalConverter'. It also manages user authentication and request validation.

classes.name: ResponseProperties
classes.description: Encapsulates HTTP response status code and message for WebDAV calendar operations.

classes.name: ICalWorker
classes.description: Handles WebDAV requests for iCalendar data, including GET, PROPFIND, and PUT, with user authentication and request validation.

methods.name: createConversionContext
methods.description: Creates a context map from the HTTP request attributes, parameters, and locale for calendar conversion.

methods.name: createForbiddenResponse
methods.description: Returns a ResponseProperties object with HTTP 403 Forbidden status.

methods.name: createNotAuthorizedResponse
methods.description: Returns a ResponseProperties object with HTTP 401 Unauthorized status.

methods.name: createNotFoundResponse
methods.description: Returns a ResponseProperties object with HTTP 404 Not Found status.

methods.name: createOkResponse
methods.description: Returns a ResponseProperties object with HTTP 200 OK status.

methods.name: createPartialContentResponse
methods.description: Returns a ResponseProperties object with HTTP 206 Partial Content status.

methods.name: getLastModifiedDate
methods.description: Retrieves the last modified date of the work effort or its iCalendar data.

methods.name: handleGetRequest
methods.description: Processes a GET request to retrieve the iCalendar data for a work effort.

methods.name: handlePropFindRequest
methods.description: Handles a WebDAV PROPFIND request to retrieve properties of the calendar resource.

methods.name: handlePutRequest
methods.description: Processes a PUT request to update or create the calendar data.

methods.name: isValidRequest
methods.description: Validates the request for security and presence of workEffortId.

methods.name: logInUser
methods.description: Performs user login based on credentials in the request.

methods.name: setupRequest
methods.description: Initializes request attributes, including extracting workEffortId and logging in the user.

methods.name: writeResponse
methods.description: Sends the ResponseProperties data back to the client, setting appropriate headers and status.
